package.description: A Windows desktop app for running multiple AI coding agents side-by-side in a tabbed and grid-layout terminal host.

en-US.description: A Windows desktop app for running multiple AI coding agents side-by-side in a tabbed and grid-layout terminal host.
en-US.longDescription: CodeShellManager is a WPF desktop application that hosts multiple pseudo-terminal sessions in a configurable grid layout. It is built for managing many parallel CLI tool sessions — Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, ssh remotes, or any shell — with full-text search across every session's output, alert detection when an agent is waiting for input, per-session git status, sleep/wake to park sessions without losing them, and full session persistence across restarts.
en-US.name: CodeShellManager
en-US.releaseNotes:
This release brings git into the terminal toolbar: a status chip and menu for fetch, pull, status and switching branch, and a worktrees menu for repos with many worktrees. It also adds drag-and-drop ordering in the sidebar and sharp scaling on every monitor, and fixes a bug where a session that failed to start could be lost.
✨ New
- Git on the terminal toolbar. Every session in a git repository shows a chip like ⎇ main ● ↑2 ↓5: the branch, a dot for uncommitted changes, and how far you are ahead of or behind the remote. Click it to:
  - Fetch
  - Pull (fast-forward only)
  - Status
  - Switch branch
  It is deliberately read-only apart from pull and switch. There is no commit, push or merge from here, and nothing is ever typed into your terminal, so a running Claude session is never interrupted.
- Worktrees menu. If you keep a worktree per task, Worktrees ▸ in the same menu does the following:
  - Lists every worktree of the repo, with its branch and state.
  - Takes you to a worktree's session in one click, waking or opening one if needed.
  - Creates a new worktree from the current branch.
  - Cleans up worktrees whose folder has been deleted.
  - Remove this worktree: closes the sessions in it, refuses if anything is uncommitted or another repository lives inside it, and only offers to delete the branch if it is fully merged.
  Switch branch also knows when a branch is checked out in another worktree and takes you there instead.
- Drag-and-drop ordering. Drag sessions in the sidebar to reorder them, within or between groups. A blue line shows exactly where a session will land, and the terminal grid follows the sidebar order.
- Open in VS Code. A new { } button next to 📁 and >_ opens the session's folder in VS Code. It is also in the sidebar's right-click menu, and appears when VS Code is installed with code on your PATH.
🔧 Changed
- "RC All" has moved from the main toolbar to the sidebar menu → Bulk actions → Remote control all, so it can't be clicked by accident.
- Sharp on every monitor. CodeShellManager now follows each monitor's own scaling. Moving the window between screens, docking or undocking, or changing the display scale re-scales the app cleanly instead of blurring it. Previously the terminal text could end up a different size from the rest of the window.
🐛 Fixed
- Sessions that failed to start were deleted. If a sleeping or restored session could not start, it was permanently removed. Examples: a WSL distro that no longer exists, or claude temporarily missing from PATH. It now stays in the sidebar, asleep, so you can fix and wake it.
- "Open in Explorer" opened Documents instead of the folder for some paths, including folders opened from a git worktree and names containing a comma.
- Smoother typing under load. Three slow operations were moved off the UI thread.
⬆️ Upgrading
Close any running copy of CodeShellManager before starting 0.10.0, including a portable copy. While an older copy is still open, the new version's terminals cannot start, and it shows a message saying so. Your sessions, groups and settings carry over unchanged.
All pull requests in this release
- docs(release): winget fails differently now — record the v0.9.0 evidence by @AThraen in #146
- docs: README comparison matrix and stand-out features by @AThraen in #150
- docs(comparison): correct Herdr licence and features, add working-state row by @AThraen in #158
- fix(perf): take three blocking paths off the UI thread and the thread pool by @AThraen in #160
- fix(sidebar): drag-and-drop lands where you drop, and shows where first by @mortenaslo in #173
- feat(toolbar): move "RC All" into the sidebar's Bulk actions by @mortenaslo in #174
- fix(dpi): per-monitor DPI awareness, and isolate --clean's WebView2 folder by @mortenaslo in #175
- Bump the nuget group with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in #155
- test(run-commands): ThrottledSignalTests wait for the event, not a fixed 500ms by @mortenaslo in #176
- feat(git): git tools on the terminal toolbar — fetch, fast-forward pull, status, switch by @mortenaslo in #177
- refactor(ui): move "Open in VS Code" out of the git menu, next to Explorer / PowerShell by @mortenaslo in #179
- feat(git): worktrees in the git menu — where am I, switch-aware, go to, prune, remove by @mortenaslo in #180
- fix: pre-release — Explorer paths, never delete a session on a failed relaunch, worktree remove safety by @mortenaslo in #182
- chore: v0.10.0 release prep — second review round, README, CI manifest check by @mortenaslo in #183
Full Changelog: v0.9.0...v0.10.0
